name: Royal Sonesta Kaua'i Resort Lihue
insider_take: This oceanfront resort sits on sacred Hawaiian land where ancient ali'i (royalty) once ruled, offering guests a truly regal experience on Kauai's stunning Kalapaki Beach.
whats_special: The resort features Hawaii's largest single-level swimming pool and sits directly on Kalapaki Bay, one of Kauai's safest swimming beaches. The property showcases an impressive collection of Pacific Rim artwork and traditional Hawaiian cultural elements throughout its 356 acres of tropical gardens.
pro_tip: Book a lagoon-view room on the lower floors - you'll have direct access to the beach and can often spot Hawaiian monk seals basking on the shore right from your lanai.
dont_miss: The daily torch lighting ceremony at sunset, complimentary cultural activities like lei making and hula lessons, and the nearby Ninini Point Lighthouse - a historic beacon that's just a short walk along the coastal path from the resort.
pros: Prime oceanfront location on Kalapaki Beach
Multiple dining venues and resort amenities
Convenient location near Lihue Airport and attractions
Spacious rooms with tropical island décor
cons: Higher price point for premium beachfront location
Resort can be busy during peak seasons
